title: IP 주소 / Subnetting

claims.summary: /25 주소 구성과 Cisco connected routes가 10.77.10.0/25 및 10.77.10.128/25로 일치.
같은 /25에서는 목적지 직접 ARP, 다른 /25에서는 gateway ARP 및 최종 IPv4 destination 유지 확인.
PC1만 /24로 변경 시 원격 .140을 on-link로 판단해 직접 ARP하고, Proxy ARP 비활성 조건에서 원격 ICMP 이전에 실패 확인.
PC1을 /25로 복구 후 gateway neighbor 재형성 및 원격 ping 3/3 성공 확인.

evidence.note: 91 assertions are offline verification checks, not 91 separate lab scenarios.

observations: Same-subnet test: PC1 -> PC3 direct ARP and ping 3/3.
Different-subnet initial test had one first-ping timeout during neighbor resolution; repeated normal test succeeded 3/3.
Wrong-mask /24 test produced three ARP requests for the remote destination, no matching ARP reply, and no remote ICMP on the routed side.
Recovery /25 test returned to gateway ARP and remote ping 3/3.
limitations: First-ping loss is an observed lab event, not a universal protocol rule.
No reboot persistence test was performed.
Physical hardware, other IOS/VPCS versions, Cisco L2 switch behavior, NAT, VLAN, STP and dynamic routing were not validated by this run.
